outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic domain map plus western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar chart of densitometry quantification per antibody; caption gives no indication these bars represent averages across replicates (no n or mean stated), so individual points are not required.
Heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Violin plots already display the full data distribution, so overlaying individual points is not required.
Bar chart reports mean ± SD (n=4) and individual replicate values are overlaid as dots on each bar.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Scatter plot where each point is an individual protein measurement; scatter plots are exempt as the points themselves are the data.
Scatter plot of individual IP-MS experiments; exempt as points themselves are the data.
PCA scatter plot; exempt as points themselves are the data.
PCA scatter plots (striatum, cortex, cerebellum); exempt as points themselves are the data.
